messages.author: ebbfc0b5d1efd8e6
messages.subject: reproduce/dismiss issue #154
parts:
Dear knitrs,

Could someone please try the minimal .Rnw file of #154 and see if pdflatex/xelatex goes crazy?

https://github.com/yihui/knitr/issues/154

I suspect there might be something broken in the interaction between kframe and high-res bitmaps, but Yihui hasn't been able to reproduce what I observe (on two different macs).

Thanks!

baptiste

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] reproduce/dismiss issue #154
parts:
Hi:

Baptiste, your example worked for me on Win7 with R-2.14.1x64 running
knitr-0.2.12 in one session and in a fresh session using version 0.3.

However, I've run into a similar issue with tables. I was getting the
runaway train in LaTeX when I created a table with the xtable()
function in package xtable using the longtable environment without
having longtable loaded as a LaTeX package. Once I loaded it in the
preamble, I managed to get knitr to produce the document, but it spit
out several error messages along the way of the form

output file: C:\Users\Dennis\TSdesc2.tex

Error: running 'texi2dvi' on 'TSdesc2.tex' failed

LaTeX errors:
C:/Users/Dennis/TSdesc2.tex:493: LaTeX Error: Somet
hing's wrong--perhaps a missing \item.

See the LaTeX manual or LaTeX Companion for explanation.
Type H <return> for immediate help
C:/Users/Dennis/TSdesc2.tex:541: LaTeX Error: Somet
hing's wrong--perhaps a missing \item.

See the LaTeX manual or LaTeX Companion for explanation.
Type H <return> for immediate help
C:/Users/Dennis/TSdesc2.tex:584: LaTeX Error: Somet
hing's wrong--perhaps a missing \item.

See the LaTeX manual or LaTeX Companion for explanation.
Type H <return> for immediate help
C:/Users/Dennis/TSdesc2.tex:631: LaTeX Error: Somet
hing's wrong--perhaps a missing \item.

See the LaTeX manual or LaTeX Companion for explanation.
Type H <return> for immediate help
C:/Users/Dennis/TSdesc2.tex:673: LaTeX Error: Some
In addition: Warning message:
running command '"C:\PROGRA~2\MIKTEX~1.9\miktex\bin\texi2dvi.exe"
--quiet --pdf "TSdesc2.tex" -I
"C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-214~1.1/share/texmf/tex/latex" -I
"C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-214~1.1/share/texmf/bibtex/bst"' had status 1

Using knit() instead and passing the resulting .tex file through
pdflatex, this message comes up after every table code chunk (and I
have dozens in this document), but by hitting return after every one,
in the end I got the document with no apparent errors; in particular,
the tables look fine.

In case Yihui is wondering, each table code chunk uses results=asis
rather than results=tex per instructions on the web site re chunk
options. I was getting this behavior with version 0.2.12.

Dennis

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] reproduce/dismiss issue #154
parts:
I think this is a know problem. I fixed it for figure and table
environments in 0.3; for longtable, it has also been fixed now on
GitHub. I tried

print(xtable(iris, caption='iris data'),
tabular.environment='longtable', floating=FALSE)

and it worked.

Both #154 and your problem are caused by the framed package, which is
quite fragile to other LaTeX environments like center, figure,
table/longtable, ... As I said in #154, I hope I can find another
LaTeX package which allows background colors and works well with these
environments.

Regards,
Yihui
